Clean Brushed Steel.description: Fine parallel brushing with sparse cross scratches and adjustable roughness.

Worn Brushed Steel.description: Brushed grain, exposed polished edges, handling marks and recess grime.

Machined Aluminum.description: Bright aluminum with fine cutter passes and a configurable anisotropic response.

Scratched Aluminum.description: Random intersecting scratches over machined aluminum, with impact pits and polished creases.

Cast Iron.description: Coarse casting grain and tiny pits under a dark oxide skin, with exposed metal on creases.

Raw Industrial Steel.description: Rolling marks, patchy mill scale and slight brown manufacturing discoloration.

Polished Chrome.description: Near mirror chromium with sparse fine scratches, soft wipe marks and fingerprints.

Old Brass.description: Warm brass with dull tarnish, scratches and deep dark deposits in recesses.

Antique Bronze.description: Aged bronze, brown tarnish and green patina restricted to sheltered cavities.

Oxidized Copper.description: Bare copper beneath granular green oxidation, darker oxide and rain washed streaks.

Worn Painted Metal.description: Steel below orange peel paint, edge chips, fine scratches and cavity dirt.

Heavy Chipped Paint.description: Broad paint loss reveals pitted steel and corrosion beneath ragged surviving flakes.

Factory Powder-Coated Metal.description: Fine textured powder coating, restrained handling scratches and slight crease exposure.

Military Painted Steel.description: Matte olive coating, rubbed metal creases, dry scratches, earth and corrosion.

Old Enamel Metal.description: Faded cream enamel with crazing, dark cracks, worn edges and thin surface scratches.

Rusting Painted Steel.description: Layered red paint over corroding steel, exposed chips, rust blooms and downward leakage.

Automotive Painted Metal.description: Primer, saturated base coat, clearcoat response and subtle wash swirls with sparse scoring.

Burned Painted Metal.description: Blistered paint with charred zones, exposed heat-darkened steel and powdery soot.

Heavy Rust.description: Thick black oxide below broken rust scales, orange corrosion and pitted cavity deposits.

Surface Rust.description: Thin irregular orange oxidation on otherwise intact rolled steel.

Wet Rust.description: Dark saturated rust with rough dry scales, low roughness moisture and glossy crevices.

Galvanized Steel.description: Faceted zinc spangle texture, thin white oxidation and fine manufacturing scratches.

Welded Steel.description: Industrial steel with local weld-like bands, heat tint, oxidized seams and soot.

Heat-Treated Metal.description: Authored gold, brown, violet and blue temper bands over brushed metal.

Greasy Machinery.description: Machined steel with dark cavity grease, thin oil, scratches and oil leakage.

Abandoned Machinery.description: Peeling industrial paint over rust, with oil leakage, dense cavity grime and top dust.

Injection-Molded Plastic.description: Fine satin plastic grain, broad mold variation and small molding imperfections.

Worn Hard Plastic.description: Hard plastic with fine grain, polished creases, pale scoring, oily handling marks and dirt.

Soft-Touch Plastic.description: Dark matte rubberized coating with velvety grain, rubbed areas and absorbed handling oils.

Sun-Damaged Plastic.description: Patchy bleached plastic with dry cracking, chalky grain and exposure-driven fading.

Dirty Rubber.description: Matte rubber grain, shallow scoring, rubbed ridges and embedded earth in cavities.

Cracked Old Rubber.description: Faded dry rubber with branching cracks, fine grain and dusty crevices.

Fresh Oak.description: Warm natural oak with long grain, darker vessel pores and restrained growth variation.

Old Worn Wood.description: Dark aged timber grain, deep pores, dents, scratches and rubbed edges.

Painted Wood.description: Blue paint following timber grain, with chips exposing warm wood and darker recess dirt.

Weathered Outdoor Wood.description: Gray bleached timber, raised fibers, long cracks, moisture staining and crevice dirt.

Burnt Wood.description: Warm timber through heat-darkened transitions into cracked charcoal and fine ash.

Oiled Dark Wood.description: Deep brown polished timber, dark pores, rubbed oil finish and sparse fine handling scratches.

Rough Concrete.description: Cement with multiscale aggregate, fine pores and isolated deep air pockets.

Old Dirty Concrete.description: Rough old concrete with aggregate, dry cracks, water runoff and dark accumulated grime.

Painted Concrete.description: Off-white wall paint over coarse concrete with hairline cracks, peeling and grime.

Polished Marble.description: Pale polished stone with warped dark veins, fine mineral variation and tiny polish scratches.

Granite.description: Interlocking mineral grains, pale feldspar, dark mica and isolated quartz with editable roughness.

Weathered Stone.description: Eroded mineral surface with pitting, dark cavities, runoff and an independently removable moss layer.

Worn Leather.description: Warm leather grain with creases, fine scoring, dark recesses and polished raised edges.

Cracked Old Leather.description: Dry fissured leather with faded grain, deep stains and severe pale edge abrasion.

Denim Fabric.description: Indigo directional weave, pale cross threads, worn raised areas and embedded dirt.

Canvas Fabric.description: Coarse neutral woven canvas with fiber roughness, stained folds and fraying exposed edges.

Sci-Fi Panel Surface.description: Coated panel substrate with contrasting repairs, edge wear, scratches and recess grime; add decals above the folder.

Post-Apocalyptic Scrap Metal.description: Pitted steel, deep rust and two mismatched paint generations under repairs, gouges, oil and dust.
